name: Streets

categories.label: Money earned from scored Streets
categories.labelVi: Tiền từ các Street đã chốt
categories.hint: Sum of $ taken whenever a Street enclosed: each Building's Valuation plus $1 per Person on it.

categories.label: End Game Scoring (remaining Buildings, halved)
categories.labelVi: Điểm cuối ván (nhà còn lại, một nửa)
categories.hint: Each Building still holding your Ownership Sign scores half its normal value, rounded up per Building; no People move. Enter the total.

tiebreakers.description: Rulebook has no tiebreaker: tied players may play another game to decide.

notes: family: tile-laying-money. Game ends when the Stack is empty and all hands are played. Building Valuations are printed on tiles and depend on Symbols/People in the Street (scorer enters computed money). Abandoned Buildings score nothing. Solo 'Grifter' mode and expansion modules (asymmetric abilities) not modelled; shared victory used as default for ties.

sources.title: Streets Rulebook (Sinister Fish Games)
